key_terms.ٱلْمَشْيُ: Walking (specifically divine walking as an attribute)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean for a divine attribute to be 'muhdath' (accidental/created) in Shia theology?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies 'walking' as 'muhdath' (accidental/created), illustrating that divine actions are contingent events rather than eternal attributes co-equal with God's essence. This distinction is pivotal in Shia kalām for refuting the Mu'tazila's view of createdness in all attributes and the Ash'aris' view of eternal actions, affirming that while God's essence is eternal, His acts occur in time. This hadith thus clarifies the ontological status of divine deeds within the framework of Tawhid.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 18.
